ai.title: Enforce knowledge file edits and fix CLI paste detection
ai.summary: System prompt updated to mandate knowledge file edits upon user correction and allow necessary changes to these files. CLI version bumped to 1.0.37. `handleInput` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts` now calls `detectPasting()` before processing input to ensure paste mode activates correctly.

eli5.text: When you were pasting large blocks of text into the command-line tool, it sometimes failed to recognize that you were pasting and tried to process the text line-by-line instead of as one chunk, leading to garbled output or errors. The tool now checks whether you are in the middle of pasting before it tries to handle what you typed, so pasted content is treated as one whole piece instead of many separate lines. A small behind-the-scenes documentation rule was also tightened so the assistant is required to save a learning note whenever you correct it, helping it remember your feedback for next time. These fixes are live today in the latest version of the internal tooling.

ai.title: Upgrade OpenAI SDK to v4
ai.summary: Backend OpenAI SDK upgraded from v3.2.1 to v4.55.4. Configuration class replaced by direct OpenAI constructor instantiation, and chat completion logic updated to use `openai.chat.completions.create` instead of `createChatCompletion`. Helicone proxy base URL and auth headers migrated to `baseURL` and `defaultHeaders` parameters. Scope limited to `backend/package.json` and `backend/src/openai-api.ts`.

eli5.text: The backend quietly switched to a newer version of the service it uses to talk to OpenAI, replacing old configuration steps with a more modern setup that points requests through the same Helicone monitoring proxy. Requests still go to the same tracking endpoint and still carry the same Helicone authentication header, so existing monitoring and billing continue unchanged. This was limited to the two backend files that handle AI requests and was deployed live as part of the 2024-08-10 snapshot.
